placements.title: Calibration status is established by verifying against a reference standard across the full operating range, not asserted from a bare setting alone
placements.frame: Does this calibration claim name the verification method and reference standard used, and does it specify the range over which the result holds?
placements.why: src-1 states the calibrated value; src-2 substantiates it by naming the verification method (June reference plates) and its scope (full observing band); src-3 restates both as a canonical record. Together they carry a thematic subject beyond this one measurement — that a calibration claim's credibility rests on citing a reference standard and a verified range, a pattern future calibration envelopes for other instruments would keep feeding. The bare value '88.4 MHz' is the fact evidencing this theme, not a leaf of its own (grain test).
